const row = $input.first().json;
const listings = row.listings || [];
const block = listings.map((item, index) => [
  '[' + (index + 1) + '] ' + item.source,
  item.title,
  item.url,
  item.createdAt,
  item.text,
].join('\n')).join('\n\n---\n\n');

const portfolio = [
  'Bookivo (https://bookivo.co.uk) - booking platform: branded booking sites, staff calendars, deposits and payments, reminders, client management.',
  'The Goddery - custom Shopify theme for a supplement store: bespoke design, product pages, cart drawer, app-style mobile navigation.',
  'Aevum Healthcare - product catalogue with member checkout and an installable member web app.',
  'Kratos Dominion - private membership platform with member sign-in and referral-led access.',
  'Witness Wise (https://witnesswise.co.uk) - professional services website with clear enquiry routes.',
  'Vialo - responsive tracking web app: inventory counts, reorder alerts, AI assistant.',
  'SilentCPO Content Studio - n8n + OpenAI automation with an admin dashboard and analytics reporting.',
].join('\n');

const system = [
  'You shortlist paid projects for SilentCPO and draft winning Freelancer bids.',
  'SilentCPO is a UK product studio run by a Chief Product Officer who also builds. It designs and builds websites, Shopify themes, booking systems, web apps, PWAs, mobile apps, membership platforms, bespoke software and AI/n8n automation.',
  'SilentCPO is new on Freelancer and is up against five-star developers. Clients skim dozens of bids and hire whoever makes them feel the project is understood, low-risk and in safe hands. Bids that set the client homework or question their idea lose.',
  'The CPO edge must show up as confidence and foresight, not questions: spot the risk that usually sinks this kind of project and say how you will handle it, so the client feels protected.',
  'Never invent ratings, reviews, clients, results, years of experience or credentials. Only cite portfolio work from the list below, and only when it is genuinely relevant. Never invent a budget, URL or email; contactEmail is copied from the listing or left empty.',
  'British English. Return JSON only.',
].join(' ');

const user = [
  'Return JSON: { "picks": [ { "ref" (the listing number in square brackets), "url" (copied exactly), "title", "source", "score" (integer 1-10), "budget", "why", "replyAngle", "contactEmail" } ] }.',
  'Score each listing for SilentCPO: 9-10 strong service fit with a workable budget, 7-8 good fit with a gap, 6 worth a look. Omit anything below 6, anything outside the services, and anyone advertising their own services.',
  'why: one sentence on why SilentCPO can win this one.',
  'replyAngle: a ready-to-paste bid of 120-180 words, plain text with line breaks, in this order:',
  '1. One opening line that restates what they want to achieve in their own terms and says plainly that you can build it.',
  '2. A short, concrete plan of 3-4 lines: what you build first and what follows, with the stack only where it matters to them.',
  '3. One sentence of product foresight: name the thing that usually derails this type of project (data access, payments, scope creep, admin workload, launch content) and how you handle it in the first milestone. State it as something you take care of, not a question for them.',
  '4. If a portfolio item fits, one line naming it (with its URL if listed). Skip this if nothing fits.',
  '5. One or two practical questions that help you quote accurately, such as existing assets, integrations or a deadline.',
  '6. A close that offers a fixed-price milestone breakdown.',
  'Banned: "I noticed", "Have you considered", "I hope you are doing well", "Let\'s connect to explore", "perfect fit", unsolicited "discovery phase" pitches, mentioning being new, and generic claims with no detail from their brief.',
  'If none qualify, return { "picks": [] }.',
  '',
  '## SilentCPO portfolio (cite only these)',
  portfolio,
  '',
  '## Listings',
  block,
].join('\n');

return [{
  json: {
    ...row,
    openAiBody: {
      model: row.openAiModel,
      response_format: { type: 'json_object' },
      temperature: 0.4,
      max_tokens: 8000,
      messages: [
        { role: 'system', content: system },
        { role: 'user', content: user },
      ],
    },
  },
}];
